brake_physical_parity.scope: Exact full COM/contact/recovery impact stream and final state, omitting only applied control/action/override fields and final configuration.

limitations: One known match and two post-hit interventions are not a general control or win-rate comparison.
Point-ray and ideal braking estimates omit hull radius, future gravity changes and further contacts.
Exact late braking parity does not prove that every earlier action must fail.
A health-aware pursuit decision or earlier escape remains untested here.
